feature: official SiglipVisionModel pooler_output (1152D MAP attention-pooled whole-image embedding)
preprocessing: official SiglipImageProcessor: bilinear resize to 512x512, mean 0.5, std 0.5
selection_protocol: per-sample L2 normalization, train-only 5-fold C selection, LinearSVC refit on 434 train images, one validation evaluation
notes: ICLR 2026 vision encoder fine-tuned from SigLIP 2-So400m/16-512px with fine-to-coarse supervision to strengthen OCR and fine-grained visual tokens.
